title: Use an isolated worktree per issue
content: Each issue uses an isolated persistent worktree and records its branch in the handoff.

title: Shared SQLite writer lock
content: Concurrent task-end writers can hit a database lock unless WAL and bounded retry are enabled.

title: Portable Team Memory bundle
content: Export the Team Memory bundle and import it on the next machine to merge reusable records by stable id.

title: Runner handoff
content: The isolated runner is ready for the next agent; verify the citation before changing the branch.

title: Keep provenance sectioned
content: Repository citations and team experience must remain separate instead of using a black-box score fusion.

title: Pending candidate
content: This candidate is not accepted and must not be used as a fact.

title: 调度链验证改在隔离工作树里跑
content: 每个议题的调度链验证都在隔离工作树里执行，验证结束后把分支写进交接记录。

title: 火山云配额超限导致回放失败
content: 并发回放会打满火山云的推理配额，超限后请求直接失败，需要限速并重试。

title: 2026-08-18 的回放交接
content: 2026-08-18 完成了配额限速回放的交接，后续由 runtime 小队接手余下的重试策略。
